g.text: NeuralForecast model argument: how each window is normalized before the network sees it.

text.style: fill: #222222; font: 7.8px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: What it does: 'revin' subtracts each window's mean and divides by its standard deviation, then reverses that on the output.

text.style: fill: #222222; font: 7.8px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: 'minmax' squeezes each window into [0, 1] using its min and max.

text.style: fill: #222222; font: italic 7.8px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: Why it matters here: One spike sets a window's max, so MinMax squashes every other week toward zero. Note: Huber δ5 acts like
